name: Mechanics of Biomaterials
description: Forces and moments. Free body diagrams. Elastic, plastic, visco-elastic, visco-plastic materials. Bending, torsional and shear strength. Stress-strain relationships of linear and non-linear solids. Fatigue loading with and without corrosion. Fluid mechanics - shear thinning and shear thicknening fluids.
